nina.design: Quick design check — trace header actions. Current mock: Export is big primary button, copy corr-id is tiny icon. Thinking flip so Copy is prominent. omar.pm: Agree. Support and QA copy ids all day. Export is an edge action. kai.eng: Backend note: large exports can take a while. If Export stays primary we need to show async states; if we demote it we still need clear feedback for queued jobs. ben.analytics: Numbers: last 30d copy =~ 3.6x export. Data backs copy-first. aria.a11y: A11y checklist if we flip: the corr-id control must be keyboard focusable, have an explicit accessible name (aria-label containing the id and action), and announce copy success via an aria-live region. Do not truncate the id for ATs. nina.design: Proposed order: [Copy 78ab-12] (text chip) | [Export ▾] (dropdown with JSON/CSV/HAR descriptors) | [More ⋮]. On mobile (<480px) collapse Export into overflow. Increase touch target to 44px. kai.eng: Implementation: exports that exceed ~5s return job_id. Client can poll /api/exports/{job_id}. For long jobs show toast: "Export queued — we'll notify you when it's ready" and optionally email/webhook. nina.design: Microstates: idle, copying (transient check + sr announce), export queued, export ready (download link + sr announce). aria.a11y: SR snippet suggestion: ```
``` Then set srToast.textContent = 'Correlation ID 78ab-12 copied to clipboard' after copy. aria.a11y: Also ensure focus outline is visible (2px) and color contrast of chip text is >= 4.5:1. If the chip is icon-only, provide aria-label. ben.analytics: Event names: trace.copy_corr_id, trace.export_requested, trace.export_ready. Include payloads: format, trace_span_count, file_size (when ready). kai.eng: We'll emit events and include job errors in export_requested telemetry so we can alert on spikes. Also keep DOM order matching logical order (Copy then Export) so AT navigation is predictable. nina.design: Also propose keyboard shortcut: when trace panel focused, press c to copy corr-id. Add small hint "Press ? for shortcuts" and document in keyboard help modal. aria.a11y: OK if documented and non-conflicting. Disable shortcut when focus is in a text field. omar.pm: Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%, monitor events and export error rates, rollback on regressions. ci-bot: snapshot uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/snapshots/trace-copychip-v1.png nina.design: Thanks all — I'll post updated mock, spec with keyboard flows, SR copy snippets, and the analytics example in this thread later today. :sparkles:
